eventTitle: IAM ACCESS GRANTED: AWS-SBG - Arcus General Assembly 001
objectives: To actively strip down social barriers between organization members, successfully transitioning unacquainted attendees into comfortable, interactive peer networks via structured icebreakers.
To deploy custom-developed mobile applications and gamified team challenges that cultivate real-time communication, collective strategy, and peer reliance.

To provide a comprehensive, transparent orientation outlining the structural duties of each executive department, the explicit benefits of student membership, and the AWS cloud development milestones for the academic year.
peoWriteup: This activity supports the development of students who can work effectively within collaborative, multidisciplinary teams, as demonstrated through the event's structured team-building exercises and peer-reliance challenges. It also reinforces students' ability to function both independently and as part of a team, reflected in the shift from passive orientation to active, team-based participation throughout the program.
coreValuesWriteup: This activity reflects the organization's Commitment by dedicating structured time and resources toward the smooth integration of newly-registered members, rather than leaving onboarding informal. It also demonstrates Relevance by tying membership onboarding directly to real, industry-relevant cloud computing competencies, ensuring the community-building effort stays grounded in the organization's technical mission. Finally, the event models Excellence through its structured, gamified framework, setting a higher standard of engagement than a passive orientation would.
